text:
Jess: just merged PR #4823 — main CI popped red on the nightly after merge. Failing job: integration-e2e / gpu-matrix. Anyone nearby to grab this?
CI Bot: pipeline failed: integration-e2e (gpu-node-4). logs: https://ci.redwood/tests/3742 
Alex: on it, grabbing logs now. @Jess can you paste the commit sha?
Jess: sha: abcdef12 — tiny kvcache timeout tweak.
Priya: looking at the logs quickly — I see a lot of connection resets and a 12m timeout on shard 2: ```ERROR: ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer
...
Timeout after 12m waiting for shard 2```
Maya: can we rerun the failed job on a different node? `./scripts/ci/rerun_job.sh integration-e2e gpu-matrix 3742`
Alex: rerun submitted (build 3743). pinging @oncall to watch the new build.
CI Bot: rerun started: build 3743 (integration-e2e) on gpu-node-7.
Sam: if rerun fails we should consider a quick bisect to isolate the change. who owns the merge? @Jess
Jess: I own the change, happy to help bisect if needed.
CI Bot: rerun complete: build 3743 — FAILED. Same test timed out at ~12m. Minimal log: ```Timeout after 12m waiting for shard 2
traceback: ... connection reset during scatter-gather```
Priya: I'll try a local minimal repro against abcdef12 in a container now — should take ~20m.
Maya: I'll kick a run on the alternate GPU pool (us-west-2) to rule out node-specific flakiness.
Alex: marking this thread incident-notice and assigning to Priya for initial debug/triage. If Priya confirms repro, we can bisect between main~5 and abcdef12. Anyone with spare cycles pls eyeball logs.
